name: 阳再线III之炎龙封印
english_name: Sunset Reborn III: Seal of the Flame Dragon
english_description: Sunset Reborn III: Seal of the Flame Dragon, produced by AKAI Studio in 2006. Like the other 'Sunset Reborn'-titled archives in this collection, it uses the Tomud '2060' client handshake, rejecting any first input that isn't literally the string '2060' before asking for an English ID. Despite the 'Sunset Reborn' title, its map actually belongs to the unrelated 'Tianya' lineage (its signature cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to xysylmhb/xyzxiiylzymh) rather than the true 'Sunset Reborn' family (xyzx/jhfy3/xajh4gkb/xyzxyl201412) — the tenth confirmed 'Tianya' family member found in this collection. New characters land at the same Iron Spear Temple starting shrine as this collection's yxjh, and a file-level comparison confirms the kinship is real but partial: roughly 85% of yxjh's file paths exist here too (the same Tianya scaffold, including matching heimuya/quanzhou/gaibang zone directories), but only about a third of that shared scaffold is byte-identical content — a diverged sibling rather than a repackaged duplicate.
